content:
alice.m: Heads up — external assessors requested a gov-cloud run next Wed 09:00-13:00 PT. They need ephemeral RBAC, a KMS envelope key for evidence uploads, and audit retention bumped. Any immediate blockers?

ben.o: gov-cloud GPU quotas are tight but sched can carve a 4h slot. main blockers: (1) KMS policy for external principals, (2) audit log retention change (we currently retain 90 days), (3) readroom creds for live debugging.

carmen: Key alias we usually use is alias/pt-evidence-2024. We should not hand over direct Decrypt; prefer envelope encryption pattern where assessors upload artifacts encrypted with a data key we wrap via KMS. Key policy must allow sts:AssumeRole for the pt-ambassador role.

dmitri: Agree with envelope flow. Proposed IAM condition: "aws:PrincipalArn" must match the assessor role ARN and add "aws:SourceAccount" == assessor acct. Also add CloudTrail write alerts and push to SIEM.

alice.m: Carmen/Dmitri — can you sketch the minimal key policy snippets and the IAM role trust? Want to present to legal before we open the slot.

carmen: putting quick snippets here: 

```
# assume-role command for assessors (for ops runbook)
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/pt-ambassador --role-session-name pt-assessor-session --duration-seconds 3600
```

Key policy excerpt (conceptual): 
- Principal: arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/pt-ambassador
- Actions allowed: kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Encrypt (wrap)
- Deny kms:Decrypt and kms:ReEncrypt unless request originates from internal ops principal

This keeps plaintext DECRYPT off the assessor path.

dmitri: Also recommend a CloudTrail event selector that captures KMS GenerateDataKey and Encrypt for that key and routes to a dedicated S3 bucket with 365d retention + SIEM ingest. We'll need to update bucket lifecycle and ensure logs are immutable for 90 days (WORM).

oncall-sre: For evidence upload, prefer presigned S3 put URLs with server-side encryption aws:kms to ensure we have the envelope flow and avoid exposing data keys. Ops can issue temp presigned links scoped to the assessor role.

ben.o: Scheduling note — we have a conflicting release freeze Tuesday-Wed morning. If legal signs off by EOD Mon we can still do Wed 09:00; otherwise we'll need to push to next week. Gridlock risk flagged.

alice.m: Understood. Action items: 
- carmen: post key policy + IAM trust doc (small PR) by EOD today
- dmitri: CloudTrail/ SIEM routing change + S3 lifecycle plan by EOD
- oncall-sre: presigned link workflow + runbook snippet
- ben.o: hold the slot tentatively; confirm if release freeze moves

security-bot: CHECKLIST: [ephemeral-roles], [kms-envelope], [cloudtrail-routing], [s3-retention-365d], [readroom-creds-window], [presigned-evidence-links]. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.

dmitri: One more thing — for retest coordination, tag all follow-up tickets with label `pt-gridlock-2024` and include the exact key alias used. That makes post-report audit easier.

carmen: Added the draft policy to PR #3142 — link: https://git.internal/repo/policy/pulls/3142 — comments welcome.

alice.m: Great. If everyone can ack the checklist by EOD we can lock Wed. :thumbsup:

ben.o: Acked. Will tentatively hold the slot.

oncall-sre: I can produce the presigned-runbook + example curl upload by 1400 today.

carmen: Acked. Reviewing the PR now.

dmitri: Acked — will drop CloudTrail config and SIEM playbook in the ticket.

security-bot: Incident note template for this window (auto-generated): 
- engagement_id: ENG-PT-2024-458
- start: 2024-08-14T16:00:00Z
- duration: 4h
- key_alias: alias/pt-evidence-2024
- readroom: ephemeral (SSO)
- evidence_bucket: s3://pt-evidence-locked/ENG-PT-2024-458/

alice.m: Leaving this thread open for updates. If legal asks for a separate KMS key per-assessor, flag asap (that increases operational load).
